title: elymus multiflorus var. kingianus
intro: Elymus multiflorus var. kingianus, commonly known as King's Wild Rye, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is primarily used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of King's Wild Rye include its antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it effective in treating a range of health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
